title: Gameplay improvements: rewards, upgrades, pet attack animation, zone gates, UI fixes
description: 1. Increase Zone 1 destructible rewards (CoinPile: 5-15, DiamondPile: 1-3, Crate: 10-30+1-2). 2. Fix upgrade grid to use actual costs from Config. 3. Fix pet attack animation to move all parts to destructible and return. 4. Add zone gate visualization and interaction. 5. UI improvements: currency popups show correct amounts, level display next to XP bar.
steps: Update ZoneData.lua Zone 1 destructible rewards to match requirements
Fix UIController upgrade grid to read actual costs from Config module
Fix PetController sendPetToAttack to move all model parts together
Add zone gate creation in ZoneService and client-side gate interaction
Verify upgrade system applies bonuses (FasterPets speed, StrongPets damage)
acceptance_criteria: Zone 1 Crate drops 10-30 Coins + 1-2 Diamonds randomly
Upgrade grid shows actual costs from Config per upgrade
Pet models visually fly to destructible when attacking and return after
Zone gates are visible between zones and can be interacted with
FasterPets upgrade increases pet follow speed
StrongPets upgrade increases pet damage (already works via PetService.getPetDamage)
